checked.note: verified in a running system - collective check on a BTP ABAP environment (ABAP Cloud), recorded on the maintainer's statement; no per-port note

deviations.what: the original controller seeds three byte-identical product arrays (/ProductCollection, /ProductCollection2, /ProductCollection3) and binds one Select to each; the port folds them into the single shared table /T_PRODUCTS feeding all three Selects - same rows, same sorter, each Select keeps its own two-way selectedKey, so rendering and behaviour are identical.
